messages.msgid: Makes Portal Storm enemies only attack the player.  Without this critical NPCs can die to Portal Storm enemies in very unfair ways.  More work needs to be done on AI and faction base security before it will be safe to disable this.
translations: 使空间风暴只对玩家有效，否则NPC可能会以非常不公平的方式死于空间风暴之中。建议启用它，直到AI和派系基础安全方面能做得更好。
